description: Generate a slide-deck-quality hub and spoke diagram: a large central hub circle with 3–10 coloured satellite cards evenly spaced around it, each joined to the hub by a spoke, with an optional short detail beside each satellite and optional arrowheads (out from the hub, or both ways). Choose it when several items relate to one centre with no order between them: a platform and its products or integrations, a team and its stakeholders, a core value and its pillars, a company and its partners. Use a cycle when the items form a repeating sequence, a process diagram for one-way steps, a mind map when the satellites branch further, and an org chart for reporting lines. Limits: 3–10 spokes, one level only, names of 1–3 words, details of about 12 words. Infer missing details rather than asking; the user can adjust the chart in the builder through the Edit link. ALWAYS give the user the image link: inline chat images usually cannot be saved, but the link renders the exact chart on demand and can be pasted into a slide or Markdown.

inputSchema.description: A hub-and-spoke diagram: a central hub with evenly spaced satellites joined to it by spokes, in no particular order.

arrows.description: Arrowheads on the spokes: "none" (default, plain connecting lines), "out" (from the hub towards each satellite, e.g. distribution or influence), "both" (two-way exchange).

credit.description: Shows a small "twominutetoolkit.com" credit under the chart, inside the card. Set false to leave it off (for example when the user asks for no branding).

hub.description: Label of the central hub, e.g. "Core platform". Bold white text in a large circle, wrapped to up to 3 lines; 1–4 words reads best.

hubColor.description: Optional hex colour of the hub circle. Default: the first palette colour (indigo #4f46e5), with the spokes taking the following palette colours.

palette.description: Hex colours applied in order to items that have no colour of their own. Pass the user's brand colours here when they name them. Default: indigo, sky, emerald, amber, red, gray.

spokes.description: The satellites around the hub (3–10), placed clockwise from 12 o'clock. Order only decides placement; nothing implies a sequence. Fewer than 3 still render but are reported as a warning; more than 10 are dropped.

color.description: Hex colour, e.g. "#0ea5e9". Optional: satellites without one take the next palette colour.

detail.description: Optional short description shown next to the satellite, on the side away from the hub, wrapped to up to 3 lines (about 12 words).

name.description: Satellite label, 1–3 words reads best (e.g. "Mobile app"). Long names shrink and wrap to 2 lines.

title.description: Heading shown top-left of the chart at 22px bold. Every chart has one title row; an empty string hides it.

width.description: Chart width in pixels (640–2400). Omit it (recommended) and the chart sizes itself to its content with comfortable margins, between 880 and 1280px wide. PNG output renders at 2x.
